fact: UIET houses a cutting-edge Supercomputing Hub for Artificial Intelligence featuring an NVIDIA DGX H100 GPU cluster dedicated to advanced AI research.
The AICTE IDEA Lab at UIET CSJMU provides hands-on 3D printing, laser cutting, and prototyping equipment for student innovators.
UIET operates an Advanced Drone Laboratory dedicated to research in autonomous aerial vehicles, flight controllers, and aerial mapping.
The State-of-the-Art Cyber Security Lab at UIET equips students with practical ethical hacking, network analysis, and VAPT skills using Kali Linux.
CSJMU Central Library is a magnificent three-storied centrally air-conditioned building offering extensive digital e-resources and automated search catalogs.
UIET offers B.Tech undergraduate degree programmes across six specialized engineering streams including CSE, CSE (AI), ECE, CHE, MEE, and MSME.
The Department of Vocational Studies at UIET offers specialized B.Voc and D.Voc programmes tailored to industry skill requirements.
UIET engages Professors of Practice and visiting experts from top IITs, NITs, and industry leading institutions for student mentorship.
UIET engineering students achieved a stellar highest domestic placement package of 16 LPA with Quizizz and 15 LPA with Cadence Design Systems.
Leading recruiters including TCS, Jio Platforms, Sopra Steria, Prospa, Virtusa, and Vodafone Idea regularly conduct campus recruitment drives at UIET.
The UIET Training and Placement Cell organizes year-round technical bootcamps, mock interview sessions, and soft skill workshops for all students.
Aman Singh from Chemical Engineering achieved an impressive All India Rank (AIR) 19 with a score of 821 in the national GATE examination.
Over 46 UIET students from CSE, ECE, CHE, MEE, MSME, and IT departments qualified the competitive national GATE examination.
Utkarsh Tripathi (CHE) secured AIR 182 and Zarish Rashid (MSME) achieved AIR 317 in the GATE competitive national examination.
CSJMU campus features modern student hostels, a dedicated Health Center, gymnasium, multi-sport complex, and active NSS units.
UIET students actively participate in national competitive coding and robotics events including the ICPC Asia Regional Contest.

Under the UP Government Fee Reimbursement Scheme, eligible SC/ST students receive up to Rs. 1,17,000 per year, while General/OBC students receive Rs. 64,500 (with hostel) or Rs. 57,000 (day scholars).
CSJMU students are eligible for free tablets and smartphones under the Swami Vivekananda Youth Empowerment Scheme (UP Free Tablet / Smartphone Scheme).
The CSJMU & UIET Innovation Center provides students with state-of-the-art prototype development labs, idea incubation, university guidance, and investor mentorship.
PEZ is a smart campus printing startup that allows students to upload documents, scan a QR code at campus print stations, pay digitally, and print instantly with automatic file deletion.
